scope: Persistent workspace grants in authenticated access and confined process execution
invariant: Workspace actions use current scoped grants, and revocation cancels only processes that lose their effective execution rights.
required_evidence: Both authorized hosts in Debug and ASan/UBSan
Full P00-P10 baseline and unchanged locked assertions
Explicit provisioning and persistent grants across broker and world restart
Authenticated selection, explicit availability, and real confined process execution
Workspace and world domain separation, unknown recipients, and foreign issuers
Read-only Git and project mounts; partial or narrow grants cannot authorize whole-project writes
Static membership cannot override a configured persistent authority
Grant and ancestor revocation cancel real processes without a recipient request
Independent execution grants, selection loss, and credential-only revocation preserve valid processes
Partial broker frames and process waits do not block issuer revocation
Launch retries cannot acknowledge processes revoked during current status preparation
Independent mutations detect missing process cancellation, excess writes, and stale retry acknowledgement
limitations: Actor channels remain inherited local sockets.
Native application observation and control need workspace and X-server integration.
Issuer state and process effects are separate transactions.
Distributed revocation acknowledgement and nonempty bootstrap profiles remain pending.
Full Spatial-M1 and physical native-session acceptance remain pending.
